description: Any public web page or PDF as clean markdown, with its title and final URL after redirects, plus the page's schema.org data (prices, dates) when it has any. robots.txt is honored. Some sites refuse automated readers; those calls fail with the reason and cost nothing.

max_chars.description: Cut the markdown at this length; truncated says whether it was cut.

url.description: Full address, starting http:// or https://.

name: read_page
title: Read a web page
